rationale: The agent did locate the user via name and ZIP (basic authentication), but it failed several key requirements. It did not provide the requested tracking number for the tablet order or address whether a refund/reorder was possible. It executed order-changing writes (cancel_pending_order on #W9373487 and #W5481803, and a return for sneakers on #W7449508) without any explicit user confirmation beforehand, violating the policy. The final message only mentions the sneaker return and omits results or confirmations for the cancellations. The user’s preference to proceed one thing at a time was not followed, and the instruction to cancel the boot but keep the kettle (or do nothing if not possible) was not clearly handled—tool calls suggest whole-order cancellations may have been performed without clarifying item-level intent. Overall, core requests were not completed and policy on confirmations was not followed.
